cgh-net.variant: three planes at Z = -8, 0, +8 Rayleigh ranges
cgh-net.budget_definition: median wall time of M19 at 30 iterations on the held-out volumes, this machine
cgh-net.accuracy: mean over planes of AC = 2 sum(TI) / (sum T^2 + sum I^2), unit-sum plane intensities
cgh-net.accuracy_cosine: DeepCGH's definition (Eybposh et al. 2020, Opt. Express 28, 26636, Eq. 3): cosine similarity of the target and reconstructed intensity volumes over all voxels (unit-sum plane intensities); rows: ac_cosine_*
